instruction: Candid full shot of a bright, minimalist indoor ballet studio. The woman in the black long-sleeve top and white tulle skirt (R2) stands on pointe in profile facing left, arms gracefully extended. Behind her, the man in the black tank top and tights (R3) holds her waist to support her balance. Diffused daylight streams from large windows, casting soft shadows on the grey floor.
elements: R3 holds R2's waist to support R2's balance
R2 is the dancer standing on pointe while R3 supports her
R3 is behind R2 as the waist-supporting partner
R2 extends her arms gracefully while being supported by R3
